MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 10
   C. 100
   D. 11

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

3. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 30

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

8. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 55

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

17. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

18. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

19. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

20. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

21. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

23. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 25

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 120

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 22
   C. 88
   D. 38

26. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 17

27. Solve for x: x + 4 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 4

28. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

29. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 15
   D. 57

30. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

34. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

35. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

36. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
